# True bulk DEG (all skin cells aggregated per sample)

```{r bulk_pseudobulk_deg}
# True bulk-style: aggregate ALL skin cells (incl. malignant CTCL) per sample
skin_all <- subset(obj, Tissue == "skin")
cat("cells:", ncol(skin_all),
    " samples:", length(unique(skin_all$orig.merge)), "\n")

counts_raw <- GetAssayData(skin_all, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts")
meta_all   <- skin_all@meta.data

samp_meta <- meta_all %>%
  distinct(orig.merge, Dx.simple, GEO.Cohort) %>% as.data.frame()
rownames(samp_meta) <- samp_meta$orig.merge
samp_meta$orig.merge <- NULL

samps   <- unique(as.character(meta_all$orig.merge))
bulk_pb <- do.call(cbind, lapply(samps, function(s) {
  cc <- rownames(meta_all)[meta_all$orig.merge == s]
  Matrix::rowSums(counts_raw[, cc, drop = FALSE])
}))
colnames(bulk_pb) <- samps
sm <- samp_meta[samps, , drop = FALSE]

run_dream <- function(pb, meta, form, coef_name) {
  dge <- DGEList(counts = pb, samples = meta)
  dge <- dge[filterByExpr(dge, group = meta$Dx.simple), ]
  dge <- calcNormFactors(dge)
  vo  <- voomWithDreamWeights(dge, form, meta, BPPARAM = MulticoreParam(16))
  fit <- dream(vo, form, meta, BPPARAM = MulticoreParam(16))
  fit <- eBayes(fit)
  topTable(fit, coef = coef_name, number = Inf, sort.by = "P") %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("gene")
}

# CTCL vs HC: all cohorts, cohort random intercept
ctcl_s <- samps[sm[samps, "Dx.simple"] %in% c("HC", "CTCL")]
m_ctcl <- sm[ctcl_s, , drop = FALSE]
m_ctcl$Dx.simple <- factor(as.character(m_ctcl$Dx.simple), levels = c("HC", "CTCL"))
bulk_ctcl <- run_dream(bulk_pb[, ctcl_s], m_ctcl,
                       ~ Dx.simple + (1|GEO.Cohort), "Dx.simpleCTCL") %>%
  mutate(contrast = "CTCL_vs_HC")

# BID vs HC: E-MTAB-8142 only
bid_s  <- samps[sm[samps, "Dx.simple"] %in% c("HC", "BID") &
                sm[samps, "GEO.Cohort"] == "E-MTAB-8142"]
m_bid  <- sm[bid_s, , drop = FALSE]
m_bid$Dx.simple <- factor(as.character(m_bid$Dx.simple), levels = c("HC", "BID"))
bulk_bid <- run_dream(bulk_pb[, bid_s], m_bid,
                      ~ Dx.simple, "Dx.simpleBID") %>%
  mutate(contrast = "BID_vs_HC")

bulk_deg <- bind_rows(bulk_ctcl, bulk_bid)
cat("CTCL DEGs (adj.P<0.05):", sum(bulk_ctcl$adj.P.Val < 0.05), "\n")
cat("BID DEGs  (adj.P<0.05):", sum(bulk_bid$adj.P.Val  < 0.05), "\n")
```

```{r bulk_volcano_ctcl}
d0 <- bulk_ctcl %>% mutate(neglog10p = -log10(adj.P.Val))

# tighter axis limits; edge points squished onto the border to cut white space
xlim <- quantile(abs(d0$logFC),   0.999, na.rm = TRUE)
ylim <- quantile(d0$neglog10p,    0.999, na.rm = TRUE)

lab <- d0 %>% dplyr::filter(adj.P.Val < 0.05) %>%
  { dplyr::bind_rows(slice_max(., logFC, n = 10), slice_min(., logFC, n = 10)) }

squish_xy <- function(df) df %>%
  mutate(logFC     = pmax(pmin(logFC, xlim), -xlim),
         neglog10p = pmin(neglog10p, ylim))
d   <- squish_xy(d0)
lab <- squish_xy(lab)

ggplot(d, aes(x = logFC, y = neglog10p)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey70") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey70") +
  geom_point(aes(color = logFC), size = 1, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_color_gradient2(low = "#2166AC", mid = "grey85", high = "#B2182B",
                        midpoint = 0, limits = c(-xlim, xlim), oob = scales::squish) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(data = lab, aes(label = gene), size = 2.5,
    max.overlaps = Inf, min.segment.length = 0, segment.size = 0.2,
    segment.color = "grey70") +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-xlim, xlim), ylim = c(0, ylim),
                  expand = FALSE, clip = "off") +
  labs(x = "logFC", y = expression(-log[10]~adj.P), color = "logFC",
       title = "Bulk  CTCL vs HC") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11)
#ggsave("figs/bulk_volcano_ctcl.pdf", height = 4, width = 5, dpi = 600)
```

```{r bulk_ctcl_malig_removed}
# remove malignant CTCL cells, re-aggregate per sample (TME-only bulk).
# only CTCL samples are affected; HC samples have no malignant cells.
nonmalig <- rownames(meta_all)[meta_all$celltype.malig != "CTCL"]
samps_nm <- unique(as.character(meta_all[nonmalig, "orig.merge"]))
bulk_pb_nm <- do.call(cbind, lapply(samps_nm, function(s) {
  cc <- nonmalig[meta_all[nonmalig, "orig.merge"] == s]
  Matrix::rowSums(counts_raw[, cc, drop = FALSE])
}))
colnames(bulk_pb_nm) <- samps_nm
sm_nm <- samp_meta[samps_nm, , drop = FALSE]

ctcl_s_nm <- samps_nm[sm_nm[samps_nm, "Dx.simple"] %in% c("HC", "CTCL")]
m_nm <- sm_nm[ctcl_s_nm, , drop = FALSE]
m_nm$Dx.simple <- factor(as.character(m_nm$Dx.simple), levels = c("HC", "CTCL"))
bulk_ctcl_nm <- run_dream(bulk_pb_nm[, ctcl_s_nm], m_nm,
                          ~ Dx.simple + (1|GEO.Cohort), "Dx.simpleCTCL") %>%
  mutate(contrast = "CTCL_vs_HC")
cat("CTCL (malig-removed) DEGs (adj.P<0.05):",
    sum(bulk_ctcl_nm$adj.P.Val < 0.05), "\n")
```

```{r bulk_malig_removed_scatter, fig.width = 5.5, fig.height = 5}
# TME-only whole-sample bulk: logFC CTCL-vs-HC (malignant removed) vs BID-vs-HC.
nm_wide <- inner_join(
  bulk_ctcl_nm %>% select(gene, logFC_ctcl = logFC, padj_ctcl = adj.P.Val),
  bulk_bid     %>% select(gene, logFC_bid  = logFC, padj_bid  = adj.P.Val),
  by = "gene") %>%
  mutate(sig = case_when(
    padj_ctcl < 0.05 & padj_bid < 0.05 ~ "both",
    padj_ctcl < 0.05                   ~ "CTCL only",
    padj_bid  < 0.05                   ~ "BID only",
    TRUE                               ~ "ns"))

lim <- quantile(abs(c(nm_wide$logFC_ctcl, nm_wide$logFC_bid)), 0.995, na.rm = TRUE)
nm_wide <- nm_wide %>%
  mutate(logFC_ctcl = pmax(pmin(logFC_ctcl, lim), -lim),
         logFC_bid  = pmax(pmin(logFC_bid,  lim), -lim))
nm_wide$dif <- nm_wide$logFC_ctcl - nm_wide$logFC_bid

# label select top genes throughout: extremes on each axis end + both diagonals,
# restricted to genes significant in at least one contrast.
cand <- nm_wide %>% filter(sig != "ns")
lab <- bind_rows(
  slice_max(cand, logFC_ctcl, n = 6), slice_min(cand, logFC_ctcl, n = 6),
  slice_max(cand, logFC_bid,  n = 6), slice_min(cand, logFC_bid,  n = 6),
  slice_max(cand, logFC_ctcl + logFC_bid, n = 6), slice_min(cand, logFC_ctcl + logFC_bid, n = 6),
  slice_max(cand, logFC_ctcl - logFC_bid, n = 6), slice_min(cand, logFC_ctcl - logFC_bid, n = 6)
) %>% distinct(gene, .keep_all = TRUE)

ggplot(nm_wide, aes(logFC_ctcl, logFC_bid)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey70") +

    max.overlaps = Inf, min.segment.length = 0, segment.size = 0.2, segment.color = "grey60") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("CTCL only" = base::unname(dx_cols["CTCL"]),
                                "BID only"  = base::unname(dx_cols["BID"]),
                                "both"      = "black",
                                "ns"        = "grey80")) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-lim, lim), ylim = c(-lim, lim), clip = "off") +
```

```{r bulk_malig_removed_gsea, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 5}
# GSEA on the malignant-removed (TME-only) whole-sample bulk DEG, ranked by t.
# CTCL = bulk_ctcl_nm (malignant cells removed); BID = bulk_bid (BID samples have
# no malignant CTCL cells, so its bulk is already TME-only). Hallmark + Reactome.
if (!exists("pathways")) {
  msig_tbl <- bind_rows(
    msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", collection = "H"),
    msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", collection = "C2", subcollection = "CP:REACTOME")
  ) %>% select(gs_name, gene_symbol) %>% distinct()
  pathways <- split(msig_tbl$gene_symbol, msig_tbl$gs_name)
}

run_bulk_gsea <- function(res, label) {
  rk <- res %>% arrange(desc(t)) %>% { setNames(.$t, .$gene) }
  set.seed(42)
  fgsea(pathways, rk, nproc = 16) %>% as_tibble() %>% mutate(contrast = label)
}
gsea_bulk_nm <- bind_rows(
  run_bulk_gsea(bulk_ctcl_nm, "CTCL vs HC (malig-removed)"),
  run_bulk_gsea(bulk_bid,     "BID vs HC"))
cat("malig-removed bulk GSEA hits (padj<0.05):\n")
gsea_bulk_nm %>% filter(padj < 0.05) %>% count(contrast) %>% print()

top <- gsea_bulk_nm %>% group_by(contrast) %>%
  group_modify(~ bind_rows(slice_max(.x, NES, n = 8), slice_min(.x, NES, n = 8))) %>%
  ungroup() %>% arrange(contrast, NES) %>% mutate(rn = row_number())

ggplot(top, aes(NES, factor(rn), fill = NES)) +
  geom_col() + geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey70") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2166AC", mid = "grey85", high = "#B2182B",
                       midpoint = 0, guide = "none") +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = function(x) {
    p <- top$pathway[match(as.integer(x), top$rn)]
    scales::label_wrap(38)(gsub("_", " ", sub("^(HALLMARK|REACTOME)_", "", p)))
  }) +
  facet_wrap(~ contrast, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = "NES", y = NULL,
       title = "TME-only whole-sample bulk GSEA (Hallmark + Reactome)") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 10)
```

```{r bulk_ctcl_whole_vs_tme_scatter}
cmp_bulk <- bulk_ctcl %>%
```

```{r qc_filter}
MIN_FEATURES <- 500    # genes detected per cell
MIN_COUNTS   <- 800   # total UMIs per cell
MAX_PCT_MT   <- 10     # mitochondrial fraction (%)
MAX_PCT_RB   <- 50     # ribosomal fraction (%)
MIN_PCT_RB   <- 5     # ribosomal fraction (%)
MAX_CC       <- 0.25    # cell-cycle score (cc.total); above = cycling

qc <- skin@meta.data
keep_cells <- qc$nFeature_RNA >= MIN_FEATURES &
              qc$nCount_RNA   >= MIN_COUNTS &
              qc$percent.mt   <  MAX_PCT_MT &
              qc$percent.rb   <  MAX_PCT_RB &
              qc$percent.rb   >  MIN_PCT_RB &
              qc$cc.total     <  MAX_CC

cat("pre-QC cells:", ncol(skin), "\n")
cat("dropped (low features):", sum(qc$nFeature_RNA < MIN_FEATURES), "\n")
cat("dropped (low counts):  ", sum(qc$nCount_RNA   < MIN_COUNTS),   "\n")
cat("dropped (high % mt):   ", sum(qc$percent.mt  >= MAX_PCT_MT),   "\n")
cat("dropped (high % rb):   ", sum(qc$percent.rb  >= MAX_PCT_RB),   "\n")
cat("dropped (cycling):     ", sum(qc$cc.total    >= MAX_CC),       "\n")
cat("kept cells:            ", sum(keep_cells), "\n")

skin <- subset(skin, cells = colnames(skin)[keep_cells])
skin
cat("post-QC cells:", ncol(skin),
    " samples:", length(unique(skin$orig.merge)), "\n")
table(skin$Dx.simple, useNA = "ifany")
```


```{r downsample_per_sample}
set.seed(42)
MAX_CELLS_PER_SAMPLE <- 5000

cells_by_sample <- split(colnames(skin), as.character(skin$orig.merge))
keep_cells <- unlist(lapply(cells_by_sample, function(cc) {
  if (length(cc) > MAX_CELLS_PER_SAMPLE) sample(cc, MAX_CELLS_PER_SAMPLE) else cc
}), use.names = FALSE)

cat("pre-downsample cells:", ncol(skin),
    " samples:", length(cells_by_sample), "\n")
cat("post-downsample cells:", length(keep_cells), "\n")
cat("samples capped at", MAX_CELLS_PER_SAMPLE, ":",
    sum(lengths(cells_by_sample) > MAX_CELLS_PER_SAMPLE), "\n")

skin <- subset(skin, cells = keep_cells)
skin
```


```{r gene_filter}
MIN_CELLS  <- 100   # gene must be detected in >= this many cells
MIN_COUNTS <- 400   # gene must have >= this many total counts across cells

counts_mat <- GetAssayData(skin, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts")

n_cells_per_gene  <- Matrix::rowSums(counts_mat > 0)
n_counts_per_gene <- Matrix::rowSums(counts_mat)

keep_genes <- n_cells_per_gene >= MIN_CELLS & n_counts_per_gene >= MIN_COUNTS

cat("pre-filter genes:", nrow(skin), "\n")
cat("dropped (low cells):  ", sum(n_cells_per_gene  < MIN_CELLS), "\n")
cat("dropped (low counts): ", sum(n_counts_per_gene < MIN_COUNTS), "\n")
cat("kept genes:           ", sum(keep_genes), "\n")

skin <- subset(skin, features = rownames(skin)[keep_genes])
skin
```


```{r per_cohort_vfs}
N_HVG_PER_COHORT <- 2000
N_VF_RECURRENT   <- 2000

DefaultAssay(skin) <- "RNA"
skin <- NormalizeData(skin, verbose = FALSE)

cohorts <- sort(unique(as.character(skin$GEO.Cohort)))
cat("cohorts:", length(cohorts), "\n")

vf_rank_tbl <- bind_rows(lapply(cohorts, function(co) {
  cells_co <- colnames(skin)[skin$GEO.Cohort == co]
  sub <- subset(skin, cells = cells_co)
  sub <- FindVariableFeatures(sub, selection.method = "vst",
                              nfeatures = N_HVG_PER_COHORT, verbose = FALSE)
  vfs <- VariableFeatures(sub)
  tibble(gene = vfs, cohort = co, rank = seq_along(vfs))
}))

# Drop TCR/BCR before ranking so they cannot be selected
tcr_bcr_re <- "^TR[ABDG][VDJ]|^TR[AB]C|^IG[HKL][VDJ]|^IGH[ADEGM]|^IGKC|^IGLC"
vf_rank_tbl <- filter(vf_rank_tbl, !grepl(tcr_bcr_re, gene))

# Combine recurrence and mean rank into one Borda-style composite:
#   rec_rank: rank of gene by n_cohorts (descending) — 1 = most recurrent
#   mr_rank : rank of gene by mean within-cohort rank (ascending) — 1 = most variable on average
#   combined: weighted average of the two ranks; lower = better
# w_recurrence controls the trade-off (1.0 = recurrence only, 0.0 = mean rank only)
w_recurrence <- 0.8

recurrence <- vf_rank_tbl |>
  group_by(gene) |>
  summarise(n_cohorts = dplyr::n(),
            mean_rank = mean(rank),
            .groups   = "drop") |>
  mutate(rec_rank = rank(-n_cohorts, ties.method = "average"),
         mr_rank  = rank( mean_rank, ties.method = "average"),
         combined = w_recurrence * rec_rank + (1 - w_recurrence) * mr_rank) |>
  arrange(combined)

recurrent_features <- head(recurrence$gene, N_VF_RECURRENT)

cat("unique HVGs pooled across cohorts:", nrow(recurrence), "\n")
cat("recurrence distribution (n_cohorts) over the full pool:\n")
print(table(recurrence$n_cohorts))
cat("recurrence distribution among the selected", N_VF_RECURRENT, "VFs:\n")
print(table(head(recurrence, N_VF_RECURRENT)$n_cohorts))
cat("selected", length(recurrent_features), "recurrent VFs (w_recurrence =",
    w_recurrence, ")\n")
```

```{r celltype_prop_by_sample}
prop_df <- skin.ss@meta.data %>%
  group_by(orig.merge, celltype) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(orig.merge) %>%
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n)) %>%

  select(orig.merge, Dx.simple) %>%

  filter(celltype == "T_Cells") %>%
  select(orig.merge, tcell_prop = prop)

sample_order <- sample_meta %>%
  left_join(tcell_prop, by = "orig.merge") %>%
  mutate(tcell_prop = tidyr::replace_na(tcell_prop, 0),
         Dx.simple  = factor(Dx.simple, levels = dx_order)) %>%
  arrange(Dx.simple, tcell_prop) %>%
  pull(orig.merge)

prop_df <- prop_df %>%
  left_join(sample_meta, by = "orig.merge") %>%
  mutate(orig.merge = factor(orig.merge, levels = sample_order),
         Dx.simple  = factor(Dx.simple,  levels = dx_order))

  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 1, color = "white", linewidth = 0.15) +
```

# Analysis

```{r load_data}
immune <- readRDS("immune.rds")
stromal <- readRDS("stromal.rds")
```

```{r unified_umap_test}
# carry the high-quality compartment labels into one shared column
immune$celltype.unified  <- base::unname(as.character(immune$celltype.immune))
stromal$celltype.unified <- base::unname(as.character(stromal$celltype.stromal.simple))

# merge the two compartments and reprocess for a single shared embedding
unified <- merge(immune, y = stromal)
unified <- JoinLayers(unified, assay = "RNA")

unified <- NormalizeData(unified, verbose = FALSE)
unified <- FindVariableFeatures(unified, nfeatures = 2000, verbose = FALSE)

tcr_bcr_re <- paste0(
  "^TR[ABDG][VDJ]",   # TCR: TRA/B/D/G V, D, J, C segments
  "|^IG[HKL][VDJ]",    # Ig V/D/J: IGHV/D/J, IGKV/J, IGLV/J
  "|^IGH[ADEGM]"      # Ig heavy constant isotypes: IGHA/D/E/G/M
)

vf_all  <- VariableFeatures(unified)
uni_vfs <- vf_all[!grepl(tcr_bcr_re, vf_all)]
cat("TCR/BCR VFs dropped:", sum(grepl(tcr_bcr_re, vf_all)), "/", length(vf_all), "\n")
cat(grep(tcr_bcr_re, vf_all, value = TRUE), sep = ", "); cat("\n")
VariableFeatures(unified) <- uni_vfs
unified <- ScaleData(unified, features = uni_vfs, verbose = FALSE,
                     vars.to.regress = "nFeature_RNA")
unified <- RunPCA(unified, features = uni_vfs, npcs = 30, approx = TRUE,
                  verbose = FALSE)
unified <- harmony::RunHarmony(unified, group.by.vars = c("orig.ident", "GEO.Cohort"),
                      reduction = "pca", dims.use = 1:30,
                      reduction.save = "harmony", verbose = FALSE)
unified <- RunUMAP(unified, reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:30, verbose = FALSE)
saveRDS(unified, "unified.rds")
```

```{r unified_dx_prop}
md <- unified@meta.data %>%
  select(celltype.unified, Dx.simple) %>%
  dplyr::filter(Dx.simple %in% c("HC", "BID", "CTCL"))

# downsample so each Dx group contributes an equal number of cells
set.seed(42)
n_min <- min(table(md$Dx.simple))
md_ds <- md %>%
  group_by(Dx.simple) %>%
  slice_sample(n = n_min) %>%
  ungroup()

prop_df <- md_ds %>%
  count(celltype.unified, Dx.simple, name = "n") %>%
  mutate(Dx.simple = factor(Dx.simple, levels = c("HC", "BID", "CTCL")))

ggplot(prop_df, aes(x = celltype.unified, y = n, fill = Dx.simple)) +
  geom_col(position = "fill", width = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = dx_cols, breaks = c("HC", "BID", "CTCL")) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "proportion of cells", fill = NULL) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))+NoLegend()
ggsave("figs/tme_unified_dx_prop.pdf", height = 3, width = 7, dpi = 600)

write.csv(prop_df, "results/prop_df.csv")
saveRDS(prop_df, "results/prop_df.rds")
```

```{r unified_da_dx_propeller}
# propeller analog: logit-transformed proportions + limma, with GEO.Cohort as a
# random effect via duplicateCorrelation (Ryan's propeller convention). Same
# shared HC reference -> BID-vs-HC and CTCL-vs-HC coefficients.
meta_da <- unified@meta.data %>% filter(Dx.simple %in% c("HC", "BID", "CTCL"))

samp_meta <- meta_da %>%
  distinct(orig.merge, Dx.simple, GEO.Cohort) %>%
  mutate(Dx.simple = factor(as.character(Dx.simple), levels = c("HC", "BID", "CTCL")))

props <- speckle::getTransformedProps(
  clusters  = as.character(meta_da$celltype.unified),
  sample    = as.character(meta_da$orig.merge),
  transform = "logit")

tp        <- props$TransformedProps                       # celltype x sample
samp_meta <- samp_meta[match(colnames(tp), samp_meta$orig.merge), ]
stopifnot(identical(colnames(tp), samp_meta$orig.merge))

design <- model.matrix(~ Dx.simple, data = samp_meta)     # HC = reference (intercept)

# cohort as a blocking random effect (propeller approximation of (1|GEO.Cohort))
dc  <- limma::duplicateCorrelation(tp, design, block = samp_meta$GEO.Cohort)
fit <- limma::lmFit(tp, design, block = samp_meta$GEO.Cohort,
                    correlation = dc$consensus.correlation)
fit <- limma::eBayes(fit)

da_prop <- bind_rows(lapply(c("Dx.simpleBID", "Dx.simpleCTCL"), function(co)
  limma::topTable(fit, coef = co, number = Inf, sort.by = "none") %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("celltype") %>%
    transmute(celltype,
              contrast = paste0(sub("^Dx.simple", "", co), "_vs_HC"),
              estimate = logFC, t = t, p_value = P.Value, adj_p = adj.P.Val))) %>%
  arrange(contrast, p_value)

cat("consensus intra-cohort correlation:", round(dc$consensus.correlation, 3), "\n\n")
cat("=== propeller  CTCL vs HC ===\n")
print(as_tibble(da_prop %>% filter(contrast == "CTCL_vs_HC")), n = Inf)
cat("\n=== propeller  BID vs HC ===\n")
print(as_tibble(da_prop %>% filter(contrast == "BID_vs_HC")), n = Inf)

# same CTCL-vs-HC x BID-vs-HC scatter as the main DA panel, Dx-scaled coloring
da_prop_wide <- da_prop %>%
  select(celltype, contrast, estimate) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = contrast, values_from = estimate) %>%
  filter(!is.na(CTCL_vs_HC), !is.na(BID_vs_HC)) %>%
  mutate(dif = CTCL_vs_HC - BID_vs_HC)

pad  <- 0.08
xr   <- range(da_prop_wide$CTCL_vs_HC); xr <- xr + c(-1, 1) * diff(xr) * pad
yr   <- range(da_prop_wide$BID_vs_HC);  yr <- yr + c(-1, 1) * diff(yr) * pad
dlim <- max(abs(da_prop_wide$dif), na.rm = TRUE)

ggplot(da_prop_wide, aes(CTCL_vs_HC, BID_vs_HC)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey85", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey85", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey80", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_point(aes(color = dif), size = 3.5) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(aes(label = celltype), color = "grey15", size = 3.5,
    max.overlaps = Inf, min.segment.length = 0, segment.color = "grey80",
    box.padding = 0.5) +
  scale_color_gradient2(low = base::unname(dx_cols["BID"]),
                        mid = "grey85", high = base::unname(dx_cols["CTCL"]),
                        midpoint = 0, limits = c(-dlim, dlim),
                        name = "CTCL - BID\nlogit") +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = xr, ylim = yr) +
  labs(x = "CTCL vs HC", y = "BID vs HC") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11)
ggsave("figs/tme_unified_dx_da_scatter_propeller.pdf", height = 4, width = 4.75, dpi = 600)

write.csv(da_prop, "results/da_prop.csv", row.names = FALSE)
saveRDS(da_prop, "results/da_prop.rds")

da_prop <- readRDS("results/da_prop.rds")
```

```{r tme_bulk_deg}
# Whole-sample bulk of the TME (immune + stromal; malignant cells already removed
# from `unified`). Aggregate ALL cells per sample, then CTCL-vs-HC and BID-vs-HC
# against a shared HC reference (CTCL all cohorts + (1|GEO.Cohort); BID within
# E-MTAB-8142 only), matching the celltype-resolved contrast design.
f   <- factor(unified$orig.merge)
ind <- Matrix::sparse.model.matrix(~ 0 + f); colnames(ind) <- levels(f)
tme_bulk_pb <- as.matrix(GetAssayData(unified, "counts", assay = "RNA") %*% ind)

tcr_bcr_re  <- "^TR[ABDG][VDJC]|^IG[HKL][VDJ]|^IGH[ADEGM]|^IGKC|^IGLC"
tme_bulk_pb <- tme_bulk_pb[!grepl(tcr_bcr_re, rownames(tme_bulk_pb)), ]

sm <- unified@meta.data %>%
  distinct(orig.merge, Dx.simple, GEO.Cohort) %>% as.data.frame()
rownames(sm) <- sm$orig.merge

run_bulk_dream <- function(pb, meta, form, coef_name) {
  dge <- DGEList(counts = pb, samples = meta)
  dge <- dge[filterByExpr(dge, group = meta$Dx.simple, min.count =5, min.prop =.1), ]
  dge <- calcNormFactors(dge)
  vo  <- voomWithDreamWeights(dge, form, meta, BPPARAM = MulticoreParam(16))
  fit <- eBayes(dream(vo, form, meta, BPPARAM = MulticoreParam(16)))
  topTable(fit, coef = coef_name, number = Inf, sort.by = "P") %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("gene")
}

# CTCL vs HC: all cohorts, cohort random intercept
ctcl_s <- rownames(sm)[sm$Dx.simple %in% c("HC", "CTCL")]
m_ctcl <- sm[ctcl_s, , drop = FALSE]
m_ctcl$Dx.simple <- factor(as.character(m_ctcl$Dx.simple), levels = c("HC", "CTCL"))
tme_bulk_ctcl <- run_bulk_dream(tme_bulk_pb[, ctcl_s], m_ctcl,
                                ~ Dx.simple + (1 | GEO.Cohort), "Dx.simpleCTCL") %>%
  mutate(contrast = "CTCL_vs_HC")

# BID vs HC: E-MTAB-8142 only (BID's single cohort -> no cohort random effect)
bid_s  <- rownames(sm)[sm$Dx.simple %in% c("HC", "BID") & sm$GEO.Cohort == "E-MTAB-8142"]
m_bid  <- sm[bid_s, , drop = FALSE]
m_bid$Dx.simple <- factor(as.character(m_bid$Dx.simple), levels = c("HC", "BID"))
tme_bulk_bid <- run_bulk_dream(tme_bulk_pb[, bid_s], m_bid,
                               ~ Dx.simple, "Dx.simpleBID") %>%
  mutate(contrast = "BID_vs_HC")

tme_bulk_deg <- bind_rows(tme_bulk_ctcl, tme_bulk_bid)
cat("TME bulk CTCL vs HC DEGs (adj.P<0.05):", sum(tme_bulk_ctcl$adj.P.Val < 0.05), "\n")
cat("TME bulk BID  vs HC DEGs (adj.P<0.05):", sum(tme_bulk_bid$adj.P.Val  < 0.05), "\n")

cat("\n=== top CTCL vs HC ===\n")
print(as_tibble(tme_bulk_ctcl), n = 20)
cat("\n=== top BID vs HC ===\n")
print(as_tibble(tme_bulk_bid), n = 20)

write.csv(tme_bulk_deg, "results/tme_bulk_deg.csv", row.names = FALSE)
saveRDS(tme_bulk_deg, "results/tme_bulk_deg.rds")
```

```{r tme_bulk_scatter}
tme_bulk_deg <- readRDS("results/tme_bulk_deg.rds")
tme_bulk_wide <- tme_bulk_deg %>%
  select(gene, contrast, logFC, adj.P.Val) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = contrast,
                     values_from = c(logFC, adj.P.Val), names_sep = "_") %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(logFC_CTCL_vs_HC) & !is.na(logFC_BID_vs_HC)) %>%
  mutate(sig = case_when(
    adj.P.Val_CTCL_vs_HC < 0.05 & adj.P.Val_BID_vs_HC < 0.05 ~ "both",
    adj.P.Val_CTCL_vs_HC < 0.05                              ~ "CTCL only",
    adj.P.Val_BID_vs_HC  < 0.05                              ~ "BID only",
    TRUE                                                     ~ "ns"
  ))

lim <- quantile(abs(c(tme_bulk_wide$logFC_CTCL_vs_HC, tme_bulk_wide$logFC_BID_vs_HC)),
                0.9995, na.rm = TRUE)

# label representative genes at every extreme: CTCL axis (+/-), BID axis (+/-),
# the shared diagonal (up/down), and the divergent anti-diagonal corners
w   <- tme_bulk_wide %>%
  mutate(x = logFC_CTCL_vs_HC, y = logFC_BID_vs_HC, s = x + y, d = x - y)
lab <- bind_rows(
  slice_max(w, x, n = 20), slice_min(w, x, n = 12),   # CTCL up / down
  slice_max(w, y, n = 4), slice_min(w, y, n = 6),   # BID up / down
  slice_max(w, s, n = 4), slice_min(w, s, n = 4),   # shared up / down
  slice_max(w, d, n = 4), slice_min(w, d, n = 4)    # CTCL-up/BID-down & reverse
) %>% distinct(gene, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(x = pmax(pmin(x, lim), -lim), y = pmax(pmin(y, lim), -lim))  # clamp to panel

# squish all points to the panel so off-scale extremes (and their labels) sit on
# the border instead of being clipped to empty space
plt <- tme_bulk_wide %>%
  mutate(logFC_CTCL_vs_HC = pmax(pmin(logFC_CTCL_vs_HC, lim), -lim),
         logFC_BID_vs_HC  = pmax(pmin(logFC_BID_vs_HC,  lim), -lim))

ggplot(plt, aes(x = logFC_CTCL_vs_HC, y = logFC_BID_vs_HC)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey70") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey70") +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dotted", color = "grey80") +
  geom_point(aes(color = sig), size = 1, alpha = 0.4) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(data = lab, aes(x = x, y = y, label = gene),
    inherit.aes = FALSE, color = "black", size = 2.5, max.overlaps = 10,
    min.segment.length = 0, segment.size = 0.2, segment.color = "grey70",
    box.padding = 0.4) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("CTCL only" = base::unname(dx_cols["CTCL"]),
                                "BID only"  = base::unname(dx_cols["BID"]),
                                "both"      = "black",
                                "ns"        = "grey80")) +
  coord_equal(xlim = c(-lim, lim), ylim = c(-lim, lim)) +
  labs(x = "logFC CTCL vs HC", y = "logFC BID vs HC", color = NULL) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
ggsave("figs/tme_bulk_scatter.pdf", height = 4.5, width = 4, dpi = 600)
```

```{r celltype_pseudobulk_deg}
# per-celltype pseudobulk (genes x sample-celltype) via sparse indicator
unified$pb_id <- paste(unified$orig.merge, unified$celltype.unified, sep = "__")
f   <- factor(unified$pb_id)
ind <- Matrix::sparse.model.matrix(~ 0 + f); colnames(ind) <- levels(f)
agg <- as.matrix(GetAssayData(unified, "counts", assay = "RNA") %*% ind)

tcr_bcr_re <- "^TR[ABDG][VDJC]|^IG[HKL][VDJ]|^IGH[ADEGM]|^IGKC|^IGLC"
agg <- agg[!grepl(tcr_bcr_re, rownames(agg)), ]

pb_meta <- unified@meta.data %>%
  distinct(pb_id, orig.merge, celltype.unified, Dx.simple, GEO.Cohort) %>%
  as.data.frame()
rownames(pb_meta) <- pb_meta$pb_id
pb_meta$ncell <- as.integer(table(f)[pb_meta$pb_id])
pb_meta <- pb_meta[colnames(agg), ]

MIN_SAMPLES <- 2; MIN_CELLS <- 10

run_ct <- function(ct, alt, cohort_sub = NULL) {
  m <- pb_meta %>% filter(celltype.unified == ct,
                          Dx.simple %in% c("HC", alt), ncell >= MIN_CELLS)
  if (!is.null(cohort_sub)) m <- filter(m, GEO.Cohort %in% cohort_sub)
  m$Dx.simple <- factor(as.character(m$Dx.simple), levels = c("HC", alt))
  if (any(table(m$Dx.simple) < MIN_SAMPLES)) return(NULL)
  form <- if (n_distinct(m$GEO.Cohort) >= 2) ~ Dx.simple + (1|GEO.Cohort) else ~ Dx.simple
  dge <- DGEList(agg[, m$pb_id], samples = m)
  dge <- calcNormFactors(dge[filterByExpr(dge, group = m$Dx.simple), ])
  vo  <- voomWithDreamWeights(dge, form, m, BPPARAM = MulticoreParam(16))
  fit <- eBayes(dream(vo, form, m, BPPARAM = MulticoreParam(16)))
  topTable(fit, coef = paste0("Dx.simple", alt), number = Inf, sort.by = "P") %>%
    rownames_to_column("gene") %>% mutate(celltype = ct)
}

cts <- sort(unique(pb_meta$celltype.unified))
res_ctcl <- bind_rows(lapply(cts, function(ct) tryCatch(run_ct(ct, "CTCL"),
  error = function(e) { message(ct, " CTCL: ", e$message); NULL }))) %>%
  mutate(contrast = "CTCL_vs_HC")
res_bid  <- bind_rows(lapply(cts, function(ct) tryCatch(run_ct(ct, "BID"),
  error = function(e) { message(ct, " BID: ", e$message); NULL }))) %>%
  mutate(contrast = "BID_vs_HC")

res_merged <- full_join(
  res_ctcl %>% select(gene, celltype, logFC_ctcl = logFC, t_ctcl = t, padj_ctcl = adj.P.Val),
  res_bid  %>% select(gene, celltype, logFC_bid  = logFC, t_bid  = t, padj_bid  = adj.P.Val),
  by = c("gene", "celltype")) %>%
  mutate(dif_logFC = logFC_ctcl - logFC_bid, dif_t = t_ctcl - t_bid)
```

```{r gsea_pan_celltype}
run_gsea_ct <- function(res) {
  bind_rows(lapply(sort(unique(res$celltype)), function(ct) {
    rk <- res %>% filter(celltype == ct, !is.na(t)) %>%
      arrange(desc(t)) %>% { setNames(.$t, .$gene) }
    if (length(rk) < 10) return(NULL)
    fgsea(pathways, rk, nproc = 16) %>% as_tibble() %>% mutate(celltype = ct)
  }))
}

set.seed(42)
gsea_pan_ctcl <- run_gsea_ct(res_ctcl)
gsea_pan_bid  <- run_gsea_ct(res_bid)

          gsea_pan_bid  %>% mutate(contrast = "BID_vs_HC")) %>%
  filter(padj < 0.05) %>% count(contrast, celltype) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = contrast, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
  as_tibble() %>% print(n = Inf)

data.table::fwrite(gsea_pan_ctcl, "results/gsea_pan_ctcl.csv")
data.table::fwrite(gsea_pan_bid,  "results/gsea_pan_bid.csv")

saveRDS(gsea_pan_ctcl, "results/gsea_pan_ctcl.rds")
saveRDS(gsea_pan_bid, "results/gsea_pan_bid.rds")
```

<!-- ===== CTCL-specific multicellular programs (CTCL-minus-BID interaction) ===== -->
<!-- The composition-robust "middle": built on within-celltype pseudobulk DEG       -->
<!-- (saved per-celltype GSEA), scored in the CTCL-vs-BID interaction space by       -->
<!-- BREADTH (# celltypes deploying it, CTCL-specifically) x SPECIFICITY (NES_CTCL   -->
<!-- minus NES_BID). A program is CTCL-defining if broad AND divergent from BID.     -->

```{r ctcl_specific_program_matrix}
# per-celltype x pathway NES for both contrasts (saved earlier)
gctcl <- readRDS("results/gsea_pan_ctcl.rds") %>% select(pathway, celltype, NES, padj)
gbid  <- readRDS("results/gsea_pan_bid.rds")  %>% select(pathway, celltype, NES, padj)

m <- full_join(gctcl %>% rename(NES_ctcl = NES, padj_ctcl = padj),
               gbid  %>% rename(NES_bid  = NES, padj_bid  = padj),
               by = c("pathway", "celltype")) %>%
  mutate(NES_ctcl  = tidyr::replace_na(NES_ctcl, 0),
         NES_bid   = tidyr::replace_na(NES_bid, 0),
         padj_ctcl = tidyr::replace_na(padj_ctcl, 1),
         padj_bid  = tidyr::replace_na(padj_bid, 1),
         dNES = NES_ctcl - NES_bid)                       # + = stronger in CTCL

# program dominant CTCL direction (over its CTCL-significant celltypes)
dir_tbl <- m %>% filter(padj_ctcl < 0.05) %>% group_by(pathway) %>%
  summarise(dir = sign(sum(NES_ctcl)), .groups = "drop") %>% filter(dir != 0)

# a celltype "deploys" the program CTCL-specifically if it is CTCL-sig, concordant
# with the program direction, AND more CTCL than BID in that direction
m2 <- m %>% inner_join(dir_tbl, by = "pathway") %>%
  mutate(deploy = padj_ctcl < 0.05 & sign(NES_ctcl) == dir & sign(dNES) == dir)

# program-level breadth + composite specificity score (n_sig >= 2 retained)
# score = sum over deploying celltypes of (-log10 padj_ctcl) * |dNES|
prog <- m2 %>% group_by(pathway, dir) %>%
  summarise(breadth   = sum(deploy),
            score     = sum((-log10(pmax(padj_ctcl, 1e-300)) * abs(dNES))[deploy]),
            mean_dNES = ifelse(any(deploy), mean(dNES[deploy]), NA_real_),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(breadth >= 2) %>% arrange(desc(score))

cat("top CTCL-specific multicellular programs (breadth >= 2, by composite score):\n")
prog %>% mutate(score = round(score, 1), mean_dNES = round(mean_dNES, 2)) %>%
  as_tibble() %>% print(n = 20)
```

```{r ctcl_specific_program_plots, fig.width = 11, fig.height = 6}
clean <- function(x) scales::label_wrap(34)(gsub("_", " ", sub("^(HALLMARK|REACTOME)_", "", x)))

# A: ranking — breadth x specificity, bar of mean CTCL-minus-BID NES, labeled w/ breadth
pRank <- ggplot(top_prog, aes(mean_dNES, pathway, fill = mean_dNES)) +
  geom_col() + geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey70") +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(breadth, " cts"),
                hjust = ifelse(mean_dNES > 0, -0.15, 1.15)), size = 2.8) +

                       midpoint = 0, guide = "none") +

# B: celltype x program matrix of the interaction (fill = dNES, size = CTCL signif)

  mutate(pathway = factor(pathway, levels = levels(top_prog$pathway)))
dlim <- quantile(abs(hp$dNES), 0.99, na.rm = TRUE)
pMat <- ggplot(hp, aes(celltype, pathway)) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = dNES, size = -log10(padj_ctcl)), shape = 21, color = "grey60") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2166AC", mid = "grey90", high = "#B2182B",
                       midpoint = 0, limits = c(-dlim, dlim), oob = scales::squish,
                       name = "NES\nCTCL−BID") +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(0.3, 5), name = "-log10\npadj CTCL") +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = clean) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL,
       title = "Where CTCL-specific programs are deployed (celltype × program)") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

```{r da_ctcl_vs_hc}
# CLR DA helper: celltype abundance CTCL vs HC, cohort-adjusted
da_clr_dx <- function(meta) {
  pl <- meta %>%
    count(orig.merge, Dx.simple, GEO.Cohort, celltype.unified) %>%
    tidyr::complete(tidyr::nesting(orig.merge, Dx.simple, GEO.Cohort),
                    celltype.unified, fill = list(n = 0)) %>%
    group_by(orig.merge) %>%
    mutate(clr = log(n + 0.5) - mean(log(n + 0.5))) %>% ungroup() %>%
    mutate(Dx.simple = factor(as.character(Dx.simple), levels = c("HC", "CTCL")))
  lapply(split(pl, pl$celltype.unified), function(df) {
    if (any(table(df$Dx.simple) < 3)) return(NULL)
    form <- if (dplyr::n_distinct(df$GEO.Cohort) >= 2) clr ~ Dx.simple + GEO.Cohort
            else clr ~ Dx.simple
    tryCatch({
      cf <- as.data.frame(coef(summary(lm(form, data = df))))
      cf$term <- rownames(cf); cf$celltype <- as.character(df$celltype.unified[1]); cf
    }, error = function(e) NULL)
  }) %>% bind_rows() %>%
    filter(grepl("^Dx.simple", term)) %>%
    transmute(celltype, estimate = Estimate, SE = `Std. Error`,
              t = `t value`, p_value = `Pr(>|t|)`) %>%
    mutate(adj_p = p.adjust(p_value, "BH")) %>% arrange(p_value)
}

meta_ch <- unified@meta.data %>% filter(Dx.simple %in% c("HC", "CTCL"))

da_all <- da_clr_dx(meta_ch)
cat("=== all cohorts ===\n"); print(as_tibble(da_all), n = Inf)

# cohorts containing BOTH HC and CTCL
coh_both_dx <- meta_ch %>% distinct(GEO.Cohort, Dx.simple) %>%
  count(GEO.Cohort) %>% filter(n == 2) %>% pull(GEO.Cohort)

da_both <- meta_ch %>% filter(GEO.Cohort %in% coh_both_dx) %>% da_clr_dx()
cat("\n=== cohorts with both HC+CTCL:", paste(coh_both_dx, collapse = ", "), "===\n")
print(as_tibble(da_both), n = Inf)

# does it hold? estimate concordance, all vs restricted
cmp <- inner_join(da_all  %>% select(celltype, est_all  = estimate, padj_all  = adj_p),
                  da_both %>% select(celltype, est_both = estimate, padj_both = adj_p),
                  by = "celltype")
lim <- max(abs(c(cmp$est_all, cmp$est_both)), na.rm = TRUE)

ggplot(cmp, aes(est_all, est_both)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey85", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey85", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey80", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(aes(label = celltype), size = 3,
    max.overlaps = Inf, min.segment.length = 0, segment.color = "grey70") +
  coord_fixed(xlim = c(-lim, lim), ylim = c(-lim, lim)) +
  labs(x = "CLR effect (all cohorts)", y = "CLR effect (HC+CTCL cohorts only)",
       title = "CTCL vs HC DA: all vs restricted") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11)
```

```{r bulk_ctcl_gsea}
# GSEA on the true whole-sample bulk CTCL vs HC DEG (bulk_ctcl, ranked by t)
if (!exists("pathways")) {
  msig_tbl <- bind_rows(
    msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", collection = "H"),
    msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", collection = "C2", subcollection = "CP:REACTOME")
  ) %>% select(gs_name, gene_symbol) %>% distinct()
  pathways <- split(msig_tbl$gene_symbol, msig_tbl$gs_name)
}

# recompute true whole-sample bulk CTCL vs HC DEG if not already in memory
if (!exists("bulk_ctcl")) {
  if (!exists("obj")) obj <- readRDS("../fig1/results/obj.fig1.rds")
  skin_all <- subset(obj, Tissue == "skin")
  cnt <- GetAssayData(skin_all, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts")
  fb  <- factor(skin_all$orig.merge)
  ind <- Matrix::sparse.model.matrix(~ 0 + fb); colnames(ind) <- levels(fb)
  pb  <- as.matrix(cnt %*% ind)
  sm  <- skin_all@meta.data %>% distinct(orig.merge, Dx.simple, GEO.Cohort) %>%
    as.data.frame(); rownames(sm) <- sm$orig.merge; sm <- sm[colnames(pb), ]
  cs  <- colnames(pb)[sm$Dx.simple %in% c("HC", "CTCL")]
  mc  <- sm[cs, ]; mc$Dx.simple <- factor(as.character(mc$Dx.simple), levels = c("HC", "CTCL"))
  dge <- DGEList(pb[, cs], samples = mc)
  dge <- calcNormFactors(dge[filterByExpr(dge, group = mc$Dx.simple), ])
  vo  <- voomWithDreamWeights(dge, ~ Dx.simple + (1|GEO.Cohort), mc, BPPARAM = MulticoreParam(16))
  fit <- eBayes(dream(vo, ~ Dx.simple + (1|GEO.Cohort), mc, BPPARAM = MulticoreParam(16)))
  bulk_ctcl <- topTable(fit, coef = "Dx.simpleCTCL", number = Inf, sort.by = "P") %>%
    rownames_to_column("gene")
}

rk <- bulk_ctcl %>% arrange(desc(t)) %>% { setNames(.$t, .$gene) }
set.seed(42)
gsea_bulk_ctcl <- fgsea(pathways, rk, nproc = 16) %>% as_tibble()

top <- bind_rows(slice_max(gsea_bulk_ctcl, NES, n = 8),
                 slice_min(gsea_bulk_ctcl, NES, n = 8)) %>%
  arrange(NES) %>% mutate(pathway = factor(pathway, levels = pathway))

ggplot(top, aes(NES, pathway, fill = NES)) +
  geom_col() + geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey70") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2166AC", mid = "grey85", high = "#B2182B",
                       midpoint = 0, guide = "none") +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = function(x)
    scales::label_wrap(40)(gsub("_", " ", sub("^(HALLMARK|REACTOME)_", "", x)))) +
  labs(x = "NES", y = NULL,
       title = "True-bulk CTCL vs HC (Hallmark + Reactome)") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 10)
```
